name: La Creu Café
title: La Creu Cafe: Your Charming Spot for Coffee & Churros in Benidorm
description: Discover La Creu Cafe in the heart of Benidorm, offering delicious pastries, friendly service, and cozy outdoor seating. Perfect for any sunny day!
paragraphs: Discover the warm, inviting atmosphere of La Creu Cafe, a charming cafeteria nestled in the heart of Old Town Benidorm, Spain. With its prime location at Placa de la Creu, 4, 03501 Benidorm, this delightful spot is not just a cafe; it’s a culinary haven for anyone seeking comfort and flavor.

La Creu Cafe stands out for its diverse menu that caters to all palates, offering an enticing array of pastries, delicious churros, and hearty snacks. Whether you’re starting your day with a fresh coffee and a pastry or indulging in one of their savory meals, each bite promises to be a delightful experience. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee and the scent of warm churros wafting through the air beckon you to sit down and savor the moment.

As you take a seat, you’ll appreciate the ample outdoor seating, perfect for basking in the sun while enjoying a leisurely meal. Customers have praised the friendly staff who contribute to the welcoming ambiance, although some have noted that service might be a bit brusque at times. Regardless, the food’s quality more than compensates for it. The highlight seems to be the well-loved pizza and a range of other gourmet snacks that leave you wanting more.

One satisfied customer, Gary Green, raves about their experience, stating, “This is a fabulous cafe in the heart of the Old Town... The coffee is really good. Definitely worth a visit on a sunny day.” With glowing reviews like these, it's clear that a visit to La Creu Cafe is a must, particularly for those seeking a blend of hearty meal options and delightful bites, all served with a side of charm.

For those who savor more than just food, La Creu Cafe provides a cozy escape to unwind and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of Benidorm. Whether you're grabbing a quick snack or settling in for a longer meal, this cafe is a local gem that promises to enhance your culinary adventure in Spain.
